arStrings.szText: "I've made progress with the whispers. Is there anything else to be done?"
For me? Nah. I’ve got orders from Gelena to figure what’s wrong with these heads. Apart from the obvious.
Mild grumbling. Doesn't like/trust the heads.
Ouna, though... She’s been the quiet type as long as I’ve known her, but not like this. Reckon something’s eating at her. She might tell you what it is.
Genuine concern. Emphasis on "tell YOU what it is"
